ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the distal-superior margins of both lobes. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration observed along the superior trailing boundary; frequency of 8-12 major peaks per lobe with pixel-amplitude variations between 2-6 pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and multiple small notches along the trailing edge indicating cumulative mechanical trauma; extensive white mottling/scarring on distal outer lobes.
